sections.title: Greece: A Journey of Wellness, Culture & Discovery
sections.subtitle: Athens • Evia • Crete • Delphi | A 9-Day Adult Wellness Journey
sections.html:
Experience Greece through a journey designed to bring together wellness, culture, nature, and meaningful time to recharge.

Beginning in historic Athens, the program combines Greece’s extraordinary cultural heritage with restorative wellness experiences, including yoga, thermal spa treatments, beautiful landscapes, local cuisine, and opportunities to slow down and reconnect.

The journey continues to Edipsos on the island of Evia, renowned for its natural thermal springs, before traveling to Crete, where dramatic scenery, traditional villages, monasteries, wine, and unforgettable hiking experiences await.

Throughout the program, carefully selected activities are balanced with moments of relaxation and personal time. Whether enjoying a yoga session, discovering ancient history, experiencing Greece’s healing waters, or exploring the landscapes of Crete, each day offers a different way to experience the country.

This is more than a trip to Greece—it is an opportunity to explore, restore, connect, and return home renewed.

sections.title: Day 1 — Arrive, Exhale, Explore Athens
sections.html:
Athens (1)

Welcome to Greece! A transfer from Athens International Airport brings you to your hotel in the capital. Settle in and enjoy an unhurried first evening. Athens is a city where ancient landmarks sit alongside lively neighborhoods and contemporary cafés, offering a wonderful first taste of Greek life.

sections.title: Day 2 — Ancient Wonders, A Moment to Breathe
sections.html:
Athens (2)

Discover Athens on a panoramic city tour before visiting the Acropolis, the hilltop complex that has watched over the city for more than two thousand years. With your guide, explore its ancient monuments and see the Parthenon, built to honor the goddess Athena. At the Acropolis Museum, the sculptures and artifacts help bring the people and stories of ancient Athens into focus.

After a day of discovery, slow the pace with a rejuvenating yoga class. Stretch, breathe, and enjoy a little time for yourself before another evening in the city.

sections.title: Day 3 — Let the Waters Work Their Magic
sections.html:
Athens- Edipsos (1)

Travel north to Edipsos on the island of Evia, a seaside town known for its natural hot springs. Visitors have come to these thermal waters since antiquity, giving the area a long association with rest and bathing.

Check in at Thermae Sylla Spa Wellness Hotel and enjoy an afternoon devoted to relaxation. Ease into the thermal waters, take in the coastal setting, and enjoy the slower pace of a Greek spa retreat.

sections.title: Day 4 — Olive Groves, Cretan Wine & Coastal Calm
sections.html:
Edipsos- Crete (1)

Travel to Athens Airport for your flight to Crete, Greece’s largest island and a place with a distinct character all its own. After arriving in Chania, visit Agia Triada Monastery, set amid olive groves and vineyards. Its peaceful grounds offer an introduction to the island’s religious heritage and agricultural traditions.

A tasting of local wines reveals another side of Crete: its vineyards and the flavors shaped by the island’s landscape. Continue to Myrion Beach Resort, settle in, and enjoy your first evening by the sea.

sections.title: Day 5 — Find Your Trail Through Crete
sections.html:
Crete (2)

See Crete’s dramatic landscape up close with a choice of two gorge hikes. Experienced hikers can take on Samaria Gorge, an approximately 16 km route through towering rock walls and rugged mountain scenery. Those seeking a shorter walk can choose Imbros Gorge, an approximately 8 km route that offers its own striking views.

Whichever trail you choose, the day is an invitation to move, take in the scenery, and experience the island beyond its beaches. Return to the hotel for a relaxing evening after your hike.

sections.title: Day 6 — A Taste of Cretan Life
sections.html:
Crete (3)

Begin at Arkadi Monastery, a landmark deeply connected to Crete’s history and identity. Continue to Margarites, a village known for its pottery workshops, where local artisans carry on a craft practiced for generations.

Then discover Cretan cuisine through a hands-on cooking experience. Work with local ingredients, learn the stories behind traditional dishes, and enjoy the pleasure of preparing food together. Later, take time to unwind by the sea.

sections.title: Day 7 — Where the Aegean Meets the Sky
sections.html:
Crete- Athens (3)

Fly from Chania to Athens and continue to Cape Sounion. Here, the Temple of Poseidon stands on a headland high above the Aegean Sea. Dedicated to the ancient Greek god of the sea, the temple is impressive in its own right; its sweeping coastal views make the visit especially memorable.

Depending on flight times, the day may also include a Greek cooking class and lunch in Athens or a group activity. Return to your Athens hotel for the evening.

sections.title: Day 8 — Delphi: Stories, Mountains & Reflection
sections.html:
Excursion to Delphi- Athens (4)

Journey through the Greek countryside to Delphi, once one of the most important sacred places in the ancient world. Set on the slopes of Mount Parnassus, Delphi drew people seeking guidance from the Oracle of Apollo. The ancient Greeks called it the omphalos, or “navel,” of the world.

Explore the archaeological site and museum with a guide, discovering the history and myths behind this remarkable place. The mountain setting offers a beautiful moment to reflect on the journey before returning to Athens for a farewell dinner together.

sections.title: Day 9 — Carry Greece Home
sections.html:
Depart

After breakfast, transfer to Athens International Airport for your flight home. Leave with memories of ancient cities, warm thermal waters, Cretan flavors, mountain trails, and the simple pleasure of taking time to enjoy them.

Kalo taxidi — safe travels!
